scientific_integrity: Elementary geometric-mean summability proved in RESULT.md; all source dates are first-public preprint dates where applicable. Independent validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The proof invokes the established compact-operator coordinatewise singular-value theorem. It establishes norm convergence of singular-value lists and their Schatten sums, not convergence of the Aluthge operators themselves; no rate in iteration count is asserted.
title: Endpoint Schatten convergence for generalized Aluthge iterates via a Carleman envelope
